…Who conducts himself with kindness, humility and love with every person. N. M. Y. (leadership). One who conducts himself with kindness — see Part 2, Letter 1 of Likutay Tifillos, the subject of leadership, letters 18, 22, 48, 49, 64; Part 2 — 1, 5, 7, 8, 16, 24.
